name: git-fs
description: Git session branches for AI agents. Every write and edit through the git-fs tools is one commit on refs/gitfs/<session>; reads, globs and greps see the branch before the worktree; writes are refused unless the bytes last read are still current; materialize copies owned paths to disk with overwrite guards; catchup rebases onto moved trunk; integrate, push, undo and scan publish with review. Native Write/Edit are mirrored onto the branch by hooks; Stop materializes.

git-fs.description: git-fs tools: read, write, edit, glob, grep, search, gitfs_*, integrate, push, undo, scan
